reason: Routes images from messages to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint when the active text model lacks image input support, then supplies the returned analysis as text.

summaries.zh: 当当前文本模型不支持图像输入时，将消息中的图像发送到用户配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并把分析结果作为文本返回。
summaries.en: Routes images to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint when the active text model cannot accept image input, then returns the analysis as text.

capabilities: Inspects image-bearing messages before model processing
Sends image data and prompts to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Replaces image blocks with returned vision text
Provides web settings for the endpoint, model, timeout, and API key
